about: Nothing gets worse (tools/no-regression.py, docs/MAINTENANCE.md): I.K.E.'s known external endpoints, the hosts it may start contacting by itself. A host a candidate contacts and main does not passes with no person only when it is declared here for that observation ("key": network/fresh-profile, the default, or network/while-measuring) and the candidate's own code names it (added lines of ike/**/*.py, not comments); otherwise it is worse. A host main already contacts is not listed: it is not new. Only a person (or Claude, with the change read in full) edits this file: it is under tests/, so the automatic fix may not touch it and a pull request that changes it never merges by itself; tests.yml reads main's copy, so a new entry counts once it is on main. Each entry: the exact host ("host"), what I.K.E. uses it for ("purpose"), the observation ("key"), where the code names it ("where"), and who declared it when ("declared").
